topic: mcp server for SAIR Challenges API

messages.content:
Hi all,
for convenience I made an mcp server for the SAIR Challenge API (see https://docs.sair.foundation/docs/ )

The mcp server can be found at https://github.com/osick/SAIRmcp including some short documentation and installation hints.

It is a small helper when working on the SAIR challenges with LLMs . It can be used for tools like claude code, gemini, cursor ... and so on. With it, the LLM can get better and more specific context knowledge about SAIR challenges.

If this post (or the tool) is inappropriate in this channel or for the challenge, I will delete it at once.
(and perhaps the name SAIRmcp is a bit missleading, it is only for the challenges API... I can rename it if needed).

Any feedback is welcome!
